query:
UPDATE sessions.sessions
             SET last_seen   = GREATEST(last_seen, $2),
                 last_status = $3,
                 title       = COALESCE($4, title)
             WHERE id = $1
               AND (last_status IS DISTINCT FROM $3
                    OR last_seen < $2
                    OR title IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE($4, title))
